designationHistory.name: Volcanic Unit, Marianas Trench Marine National Monument
designationHistory.indexText: Secretary of the Interior Dirk Kempthorne's Order 3284 directed that the Volcanic Unit of the Marianas Trench Marine National Monument, the submerged lands around 21 volcanic sites, be managed as a unit of the National Wildlife Refuge System.
designationHistory.note: Identification of the Mariana Arc of Fire NWR with the monument's Volcanic Unit rests on FWS descriptions; when the unit took this name was not verified. Monument proclaimed January 6, 2009 (Proclamation 8335).
